posts.title: Piccolo - A Stackless Lua Interpreter
posts.description: piccolo is an interpreter for the Lua language written in pure, mostly safe Rust with an eye towards safe sandboxing and resiliency. It uses gc-arena for its garbage collection system, and in fact gc-arena was originally created as part of piccolo . You can try it out below in an the interactive REPL.
